name: Customer
description: Stores customer information and contact details for order processing and management

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the customer

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Customer's full name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Customer's email address for communication and account identification

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Customer's primary contact phone number

fields.name: shippingAddress
fields.description: Customer's default shipping address

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the customer account is active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the customer record was created

name: Product
description: Stores product catalog information including SKU, pricing, and inventory levels for order processing and availability checks

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the product

fields.name: sku
fields.description: Stock Keeping Unit - unique product code for inventory tracking

fields.name: name
fields.description: Product name or title

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed product description

fields.name: price
fields.description: Current selling price of the product

fields.name: inventoryQuantity
fields.description: Current available stock quantity

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if product is currently available for purchase

name: Order
description: Central data model tracking orders through the complete fulfillment lifecycle from placement to delivery

fields.name: orderId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the order

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer who placed the order

fields.name: orderDate
fields.description: Timestamp when the order was placed

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current workflow status (pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled)

fields.name: totalAmount
fields.description: Total order value including all line items and fees

fields.name: paymentStatus
fields.description: Payment processing status (pending, paid, failed, refunded)

fields.name: shippingAddress
fields.description: Delivery address for order fulfillment

fields.name: trackingNumber
fields.description: Shipping carrier tracking identifier

relationships.description: Each order belongs to one customer
Each order contains multiple line items linking to products
